feature_spec.description: Explicit Lipophilicity structure schema built from the committed label-free raw graph. Atom/bond/global widths and vocabularies are independent of legacy_zinc.  Disconnected molecules and isolated atoms are supported with finite statistics.
feature_spec.name: lipo_v1

information_items.carrier: atom_feat[atom_type] 16-d one-hot; S1 nbr_code; S2 path_cat/path_end63; global distinct_atom_types
5 aromatic element classes in atom_type; AROMATIC bond_class; global aromatic_atom_fraction / bond_aromatic_fraction
atom_feat[formal_charge] 6-d one-hot (-2,-1,0,+1,+2,UNK); global charged_atom_fraction / mean_formal_charge / max_abs_formal_charge / unknown_charge_fraction
information_items.caveat: not part of the S1/S2 joint codes; reaches radius 2 only through the S2 content term a[path_end]*gate

information_items.carrier: atom_feat[n_hydrogens] 6-d one-hot (0..4, 4+, UNK); global mean_hydrogens / unknown_hydrogen_fraction
information_items.caveat: same as formal charge: atom-level only, not in the S1/S2 codes

information_items.carrier: atom_feat[degree] 6-d one-hot; atom_scalar log1p_degree; global max_degree / terminal_atom_fraction
bond_feat[bond_class] 5-d one-hot (SINGLE/DOUBLE/TRIPLE/AROMATIC/UNK); S1 code (...,bond_type); S2 code (bt1,bt2); global bond_*_fraction

atom_feat in_ring/min_ring_size/ring_bond_count/ring_bond_fraction/is_fused_or_spiro; bond_feat is_ring/exactly_one_endpoint_in_ring/both_endpoints_in_ring; global ring_* / n_ring_systems / ring_sizeK_fraction / fused_ring_atom_fraction
the 44 lipo_v1 global fields (size, bonds, junctions, cyclomatic rank, distances, degree/junction profiles, bond-class and ring-size fractions)
the SMILES ionic form is carried by atom_feat[formal_charge] + n_hydrogens
information_items.caveat: the *protonation equilibrium* / pKa and any alternate protomer are not represented and are not derivable from the given graph

information_items.carrier: bond_feat[stereo] 5-d one-hot (NONE,E,Z,OTHER,UNK) from raw edge_stereo
information_items.caveat: enters h only through the radius-1 bond aggregate b_sum/b_mean; S1/S2 joint codes are stereo-blind and the global block has no stereo statistic

information_items.carrier: none -- raw artifact has no field for it; atom_feat has no chirality block
information_items.caveat: RDKit exposes it (Atom.GetChiralTag / FindMolChiralCenters); the frozen raw-adapter never reads it

information_items.carrier: none
information_items.caveat: not read from RDKit; no dataset in this round is expected to rely on it

information_items.carrier: not named; an alternating single/double pattern is expressible through the S2 (bt1,bt2) joint code and the aromatic bond class
information_items.caveat: the model must learn the conjugation rule from bond-order pairs; no explicit conjugated flag exists

information_items.carrier: not named; determined by (element, bond orders, hydrogen count, formal charge) which are all present
information_items.caveat: sp/sp2/sp3 must be inferred by the model from those four channels

information_items.carrier: not present as a named feature; a deterministic RDKit/Lipinski rule (N,O,S with H / lone pairs) is needed
information_items.caveat: atom-level N/O/S + H count + charge are available, so the information is *derivable* in principle

information_items.carrier: hetero-element one-hots + formal charge + hydrogen count + ring context; no electronegativity value or partial-charge descriptor
information_items.caveat: a Gasteiger/MMFF partial charge would be an EXTRA_COMPUTE prior, not new structural information

information_items.carrier: aromatic_atom_fraction + n_ring_systems + ring-size fractions; the *aromatic ring count* is not a named field
information_items.caveat: derivable from the aromatic atom set and the biconnected-block decomposition

information_items.carrier: global n_components / frac_unreachable_pairs; the raw adapter counts RDKit fragments
not present; element composition is present, so MW is a fixed linear functional of the atom_type histogram
information_items.caveat: adding it would inject the periodic table as an external prior; it is not new graph information

information_items.carrier: not present; requires the Ertl fragment table over N/O/S environments
information_items.caveat: the fragments are functions of (element, H count, charge, ring/aromatic context), all of which are present

information_items.carrier: not present; Crippen/Wildman atom-typing rules would be needed
information_items.caveat: logD also depends on the experimental pH / ionisation state, which the graph does not carry

information_items.carrier: none
information_items.caveat: the input is a 2-D molecular graph; no conformer, no 3-D descriptor

information_items.carrier: none -- the supplied SMILES fixes one tautomer
information_items.caveat: tautomer enumeration would require external rules and would change the sample definition

information_items.carrier: none
information_items.caveat: BACE / HIV / Tox21 activity is not a function of the 2-D graph alone

joint_codes.note: S1 is one jointly typed statistic per incident bond; S2 is one jointly typed statistic per ordered non-backtracking 2-path, plus a separate joint (end type, bond2) code, the triangle-closure flag and a gated copy of the end atom's full atom representation. Neither is a sum of element and bond-order marginals. The middle<->end pairing inside S2 is NOT additive (see s2_pairing).

s2_pairing.conclusion: with a fixed set of additive codes the middle<->end pairing is only representable through the rank-32 multiplicative term; it is not part of any additive S2 code

not_read_from_rdkit: Bond.GetStereoAtoms() (the substituent identity behind an E/Z label)

scope: 2-D molecular graph only, lipo_v1 FeatureSpec, frozen LCRC-A forward. No learned-importance claim is made; see each section's interpretation field.

sensitivity.interpretation: A field is 'wired' iff perturbing one of its columns changes h or y. This proves the computational graph consumes the declared block; it does NOT measure learned importance. Local atom/bond/path fields must move h; global fields only reach y through rho.
sensitivity.model: LCRC-A, seed 0, random init (wiring test only)
